title: Tentative · Thursday · familiar routines and independent evidence
arrival: This is our working plan. We may adjust it to finish learning well.
note: Tentative plan: adjust to actual learning and school notices. Resume unfinished work before advancing; use Nevermoor’s actual class bookmark, or begin the opening if needed. Teacher projector plus paper is sufficient. LST and extra device bookings are unconfirmed. Record actual outcomes separately. Keep familiar paper-ready tasks available and check any school timetable changes before teaching.

blocks.title: Arrival and attendance
blocks.notes: Attendance before form collection. Collect routine forms afterward; preview tentative day.
studentSteps: Answer attendance, then hand in any forms.
Look at today’s plan and get paper and a pencil ready.

blocks.title: Mathematics · practise the current route
blocks.notes: Use the latest check to select one familiar model, two matched questions and one independent explanation. Number option: 0.405 < 0.45; 6.085 to hundredths is 6.09. If multiplication has been taught, revisit 24 × 15 = 360. Keep answers hidden until the first attempt.
blocks.firstAction: Start with one example we have already learned.
studentSteps: Try the model on paper or a whiteboard.
Explain which place or strategy supports your answer.
Complete one independent check; use it to choose our next step.

blocks.title: Library · book exchange
blocks.notes: Established Thursday book exchange; return to class by 9:35.
blocks.firstAction: Bring your library book and follow the exchange routine.
blocks.firstActionKo: 도서관 책을 가져오고 정해진 순서대로 반납과 대출을 하세요.

blocks.title: English Language Arts · Nevermoor
blocks.notes: Leave the exact bookmark, available text/audio and one familiar prompt for whoever teaches. Use the usual evidence-response routine. If the class source is unavailable, switch to choice reading with an idea/detail response.
blocks.firstAction: Recall the last part we actually heard, or listen to the opening.
studentSteps: Listen for a character or setting detail.
Write, draw or say an idea and the detail that supports it.
Keep one question for our next reading.
blocks.firstActionKo: 지난번에 들은 마지막 부분을 떠올리거나 이야기의 시작 부분을 들으세요.

blocks.title: Snack
blocks.firstAction: Have your snack and tidy your space.

blocks.title: Social Studies · evidence and source checking
blocks.notes: Use a previously studied source detail. State what it supports and what remains unknown. Keep this a short retrieval before gym.
blocks.firstAction: Look at the claim and find the source that could check it.
studentSteps: Separate what the source says from what you think.
Point to an exact detail that supports or changes a claim.
Write one careful conclusion and one remaining question.
blocks.firstActionKo: 주장을 살펴보고 이를 확인할 수 있는 자료를 찾으세요.

blocks.title: Physical and Health Education · shared gym
blocks.notes: Choose a familiar cooperative passing/target activity after checking space, equipment and access. Warm up, practise controlled movements at a suitable distance, then play a short challenge and cool down. Adjust equipment, distance or role so everyone participates.
blocks.firstAction: Listen to the safety directions and choose a way to join.
studentSteps: Practise a controlled pass or target movement.
Help everyone get an active turn.
Name one action that helped the group.
blocks.firstActionKo: 안전 수칙을 듣고 참여할 방법을 고르세요.

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.notes: Usual intermediate routine: outside 11:50–12:12; transition 12:12–12:13; eating 12:13–12:35.
blocks.firstAction: Follow our outside-play and lunch routine.
blocks.firstActionKo: 바깥 놀이와 점심시간에는 정해진 순서대로 하세요.

blocks.title: Quiet individual time
blocks.notes: Preserve a calm reset; a quiet non-reading choice is available.
blocks.firstAction: Choose quiet reading, drawing or an unfinished task.
blocks.firstActionKo: 조용히 책 읽기, 그림 그리기, 끝내지 못한 활동 중 하나를 고르세요.

blocks.title: Career Education · inquiry work and a clear handoff
blocks.notes: Use only the activity and resources already begun. Initial check: what can I do next independently? Continue or revise the paper evidence record, then explain an action/skill/possible work connection. Finish with one supported insight, one uncertainty and a clear next-step note.
blocks.firstAction: Find your question, available source and next-step note.
studentSteps: Work from your last clear stopping point.
Add or improve one piece of evidence.
Leave a reflection and a next-step note.
blocks.titleKo: 진로 교육 · 탐구와 이어서 할 일 정리
blocks.firstActionKo: 탐구 질문, 사용할 자료, 다음 단계 메모를 찾으세요.

blocks.title: Planners, jobs and cleanup
blocks.notes: Keep routine cleanup around 2:00; move unfinished learning forward.
blocks.firstAction: Restore our room and record any confirmed reminders.
blocks.firstActionKo: 교실을 정리하고 확정된 안내 사항을 적으세요.

blocks.title: Classroom community
blocks.notes: Use a short check-in, appreciation or familiar cooperative game. Students may speak, draw, point or pass; keep feedback specific and avoid public rankings.
blocks.firstAction: Notice one helpful action from today.
studentSteps: Offer one specific appreciation or listen.
Name a small next step for tomorrow.
blocks.firstActionKo: 오늘 도움이 된 행동 한 가지를 떠올려 보세요.

blocks.title: Pack up and dismissal
blocks.firstAction: Check your belongings and get ready for a calm departure.
blocks.firstActionKo: 자기 물건을 확인하고 차분히 하교할 준비를 하세요.

backups: Carry unfinished learning into the next suitable block rather than adding a second full lesson.
If the projector or sign-in fails, use paper, the board and available class materials.
